description: Field definition used by signing templates and submission snapshots.

members.name: Areas
members.description: Document areas where this field appears.

members.name: DefaultValue
members.description: Default field value. The concrete type depends on the field type.

members.name: Descriptions
members.description: Localized user-facing descriptions and help text.

members.name: Labels
members.description: Localized user-facing labels shown to signers.

members.name: Options
members.description: Choice options for select, radio, and multiple-choice fields.

members.name: Prefillable
members.description: Whether the field can be prefilled before sending.

members.name: ReadOnly
members.description: Whether the field value is read-only for the signer.

members.name: Required
members.description: Whether the signer must provide a value.

members.name: SubmitterUuid
members.description: Signer role identifier this field belongs to.

members.name: Title
members.description: Optional user-facing title shown during signing.

members.name: Titles
members.description: Localized user-facing titles shown during signing.
